# WebPuppet

> WebPuppet is a high-performance, browser-based Character Animator clone that runs entirely client-side. It drives hierarchical 2D puppets from webcam face tracking (MediaPipe Face Landmarker in a WebWorker), audio-reactive lip sync, and keyboard/UI triggers — rendered with Pixi.js.

## When to use WebPuppet

Use WebPuppet to animate layered 2D puppets in real time from a webcam and microphone, record performance takes on a timeline, or explore Character Animator–style behaviors (head tracking, blink, eye gaze, nutcracker jaw, breathe, physics, walk, dragger, swap sets, triggers) without desktop Adobe software.

Do not use WebPuppet as a server-side rendering or cloud inference product. Computer vision and audio analysis run in the visitor's browser; camera/mic permissions are required for tracking.

## Characters

Procedural multi-layer puppets with tagged layers, mouth swap sets, and triggers:

- The Jester Co-Host — WhatTheWeb jester; physics bells; juggle / laugh triggers
- The Grumpy Crypto Bull — suit; separate brows/pupils; mouth swap set
- Over-Caffeinated Robot Intern — screen face; spring arms; salute / overdrive
- The Wise Old Owl Mentor — glasses; beak open/closed; tassel physics
- The Pixel-Art Street Kid — hard-edge 16-color pixel art; three mouth shapes
- Classic Host — original sample peach-skin host

## Core capabilities

- Webcam face tracking via MediaPipe Face Landmarker (WebWorker + SharedArrayBuffer / transferable buffers)
- Audio lip sync (Web Audio → viseme weights → mouth swap sets)
- Modular behaviors: head tracking, blink, auto-blink, eye gaze, nutcracker jaw, breathe, physics, walk, dragger
- Keyboard and on-screen triggers / swap sets
- Timeline keyframe record and playback
- Pixi.js hierarchical viewport canvas

## Technical notes for agents

- Stack: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Pixi.js, `@mediapipe/tasks-vision`
- Cross-origin isolation: `Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin` and `Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: credentialless` (enables SharedArrayBuffer)
- No authenticated API surface; all runtime media processing is client-side
- Prefer linking humans and agents to `/llms-full.txt` for implementation detail
